question: In February 2025, which US pharma firm announced a $200 million investment in its technology center in Hyderabad, focusing on AI and data science?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amgen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amgen**, a leading US-based biopharmaceutical company, announced a significant **$200 million investment** in its technology center located in **Hyderabad**, India, in **February 2025**.
 
• The investment focuses on enhancing their **AI (Artificial Intelligence)** and **data science capabilities**, which are crucial for advancing drug discovery and development.
 
• This move aligns with Amgen's global strategy of leveraging **cutting-edge technology** to improve healthcare solutions and optimize operational efficiency.
 
• Hyderabad has emerged as a prominent hub for **biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries**, attracting global firms due to its advanced infrastructure and skilled workforce.
 
• The initiative is expected to create numerous opportunities for **employment** and **collaborative innovation** in India, further enhancing the city's reputation as a major player in the pharma and tech sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Amgen Overview:**

 
 
• Amgen, headquartered in **Thousand Oaks, California, USA**, is one of the world's largest independent biotechnology firms.
 
• The company specializes in **biopharmaceuticals** and is known for its innovative therapies targeting serious illnesses like cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and bone health.
 
• It is committed to utilizing **data science** and **AI-driven technologies** to accelerate drug development and improve patient outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad as a Pharmaceutical Hub:**
 
 
• Known as the "**Genome Valley**," Hyderabad is a leading destination for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.
 
• The city offers a robust ecosystem with **world-class R&D facilities**, skilled professionals, and government support through initiatives like the **Telangana Life Sciences Vision 2030**.
 
• Many global companies, including Pfizer, Novartis, and GSK, have established their operations in Hyderabad.
 
 
 
• **Role of AI and Data Science in Pharmaceuticals:**
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence** and **data science** are transforming the pharmaceutical industry by enabling rapid analysis of complex biological data.
 
• These technologies support **drug discovery**, **personalized medicine**, and **clinical trials** while reducing costs and improving efficiency.
 
• Companies like Amgen are investing heavily in these areas to maintain a competitive edge and bring innovative therapies to market faster.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Foreign Investments in India:**
 
 
• India's pharmaceutical sector has attracted significant **FDI (Foreign Direct Investment)**, contributing to the growth of domestic industries and technology adoption.
 
• Government initiatives such as "**Make in India**" and "**Pharma Vision 2020**" aim to position India as a global leader in the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors.
 
• Investments like Amgen's strengthen India's position as an innovation hub and create opportunities for economic growth and skill development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pfizer:**

 
 
• A leading pharmaceutical company headquartered in the **USA**.
 
• Specializes in vaccines, oncology, and consumer healthcare.
 
• While Pfizer has a presence in India, it did not announce the specific $200 million investment in Hyderabad in February 2025.
 
 
 
• **Merck:**
 
 
• Another major pharmaceutical company, known as **MSD** outside the US and Canada.
 
• Focuses on innovative medicines, vaccines, and animal health.
 
• Merck is active in India but was not the company that made this specific investment.
 
 
 
• **Johnson & Johnson:**
 
 
• A globally recognized brand in pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and consumer health products.
 
• Its investment strategies in India include healthcare infrastructure and innovation, but this specific announcement was not made by J&J.
